observations: Photo 0 shows a single blue manual hand pallet jack/pallet truck sitting outdoors on dirt/rubble.
A nameplate/sticker is visible on the body but text is too small/blurred to read any brand, model, or capacity rating.
Forks show scuffing and some wear; wheels/casters are not clearly visible under the forks.
Background shows unrelated items (generator, bucket, bags, a seated person) - a casual outdoor sales setting, not a warehouse.
Only one pallet jack is visible despite seller claiming two units (2.2 ton and 3 ton) are being sold.

claims.evidence: No shipping label, customs mark, or country-of-origin text is legible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Two pallet jacks imported from USA, 2.2 tons and 3 tons
claims.evidence: Only one unit is shown in photo 0; the second unit is not pictured.

claims.claim: Capacity of this unit (2.2 ton or 3 ton)
claims.evidence: Nameplate on the jack body is visible but the capacity text is unreadable in photo 0.

risks.risk: True load capacity cannot be confirmed, and 2.2t vs 3t units differ materially in price.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the nameplate/capacity sticker showing legible tonnage and model.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower disclosed capacity (2.2 ton) as worst case

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump mechanism may be worn, leaking, or not lifting properly.
risks.proof: Short video clip of the jack being pumped to raise forks and then lowered smoothly under a loaded pallet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing hydraulic service

risks.risk: Wheels/casters condition (cracked, flat-spotted, or seized) not visible in this angle.
risks.proof: Photo of the steering wheel and load rollers from the side/underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn wheels needing replacement

risks.risk: Structural rust or frame damage hidden by dirt/paint.
risks.proof: Photos from both sides and underneath showing frame welds and fork undersides.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-plus-unknown-structural risk, i.e. lower tier

risks.risk: Second unit (3 ton) condition and existence is unconfirmed.
risks.proof: A separate photo clearly showing the second pallet jack with its own nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified listing, not priced as part of this unit

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate/capacity sticker on this pallet jack.
Video of the pump handle being operated to lift and lower the forks.
Photos of the wheels, rollers, and underside of the forks.
A photo of the second claimed pallet jack (3 ton) with its own nameplate.
response.reason: The item is clearly a manual pallet jack, but the capacity rating that determines its price tier is on an unreadable nameplate, and a second claimed unit is not shown at all, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without the nameplate and hydraulic-function proof.
